author: Andrew Aronoff
text: I have zero problems with sensors falling off. None. I do not press the adhesive or use special potions, lotions or notions. I use smith&nephew IV3000 dressings, size 2 3/8" x 2 3/4". They generally remain affixed for 2 weeks and do not provoke allergic reactions on my skin. I've been using them for years. Please note that I do not swim regularly.
